passages.quote: Your attacks deal <bold>double damage</bold> and <bold>stun</bold> this round.
Draw 3 cards from {{ game.vars.cardIcon_type_reward }}. Choose 2 drawn to shuffle back into the {{ game.vars.cardIcon_type_reward }}.
Shuffle any 3 cards from your <bold>R.F.D. pile</bold> back into your deck.
Party may individually move 1 tile and prevent all imminent <bold>area effects</bold>.
Choose a character to: Draw 1 {{ game.vars.cardIcon_type_reward }}, <italic>reroll</italic> an attack and defense, and move +1 tile this round.
Choose an enemy miniature or a trap tile. Move it 1 step in any of its adjacent directions.
Party can indiv. <bold>defend</bold> 1 attack each per round with a +2 to it for <bold>1 round</bold>.
You prevent being targeted by any <bold>attack</bold> or <bold>direct combat effects</bold> for <bold>1 round</bold>.
Characters can: both attack and defend each turn for <bold>1 round</bold>. <italic>Reroll</italic> each combat dice and pick the best result.
Party indv. <italic>draws</italic> 1 card from <bold>discard pile</bold> or <bold>R.F.D.</bold> every time a character <bold>attack</bold> or <bold>defend</bold> for <bold>1 round</bold>.
Move up to 3 straight steps and ignore <bold>area effects and obstacles</bold>. In combat, if you land adjacent to an enemy, <italic>roll</italic> an attack with <bold>double damage</bold>.
Move up to 3 straight steps and ignore <bold>area effects and obstacles</bold>. In combat, if you land adjacent to an enemy, <italic>roll</italic> 2 attacks.

Move up to 3 steps and ignore <bold>area effects and obstacles</bold>. In combat, if you land adjacent to an enemy, draw 2 {{ game.vars.cardIcon_type_reward }} and ignore any direct attacks for <bold>1 round</bold>.

Move up to 3 steps and ignore <bold>area effects and obstacles</bold>. In combat, if you land adjacent to an enemy, draw 2 from <bold>discard</bold> or <bold>R.D.F.</bold> and ignore any direct attacks for <bold>1 round</bold>.
